purpose: A floating Liquid Glass tab bar with a lens that follows the selected tab on a spring, and that shrinks to the selected tab while content scrolls down. For compact width: at regular width use the system sidebar.
accessibility: Each tab is a VoiceOver button with its title and the selected trait, at least 44 pt tall. When collapsed the selected tab stays reachable and a tap expands the bar. Labels grow with text size. Reduce Motion drops the spring. Requires iOS 26.
name: LivingTabBar
